I have farmed this land for many years and know what my soil needs. For this barley plot, I will spread manure from my cows and sheep because it keeps the land strong, and I will also use a small bag of chemical fertilizer from the farmers' cooperative to help the crop grow well. I have kept barley seed from last season to plant, and my children and I will do all the work ourselves since the plot is small. We have no irrigation water here, and barley does not need spraying with chemicals like some other crops.
